Chhattisgarh, India  ·  Solar-powered  ·  Zero cold chain

Farm glut happens.
Value loss
doesn't have to.

GlutStop is a truck-mounted mobile processing unit that arrives at farm clusters during harvest glut, buys distress produce at a guaranteed floor price, and converts it to shelf-stable output on-site — powered entirely by solar energy.

Every bumper season. Same story.

Prices crash the moment harvests peak. Farmers sell below cost. Produce rots or gets dumped on highways. No fix has arrived at the farmgate — until now.

Rs.2

Tomato farmgate price during glut in Rajnandgaon — vs Rs.40–45 at peak season

40%+

Average price crash during bumper harvest across Chhattisgarh's farm districts

Zero

Mobile processing units currently deployed anywhere in Chhattisgarh today

Processing comes to the farm. Not the other way around.

GlutStop doesn't prevent the loss — it intercepts it. The truck arrives when prices crash, buys at a floor price, processes on-site, and leaves when the glut clears.

Before GlutStop
  • Sells at Rs.2–4/kg — below cultivation cost
  • Dumps produce on roads or feeds to cattle
  • Borrows from moneylenders to survive off-season
  • No advance notice of price crash — blind to glut
After GlutStop
  • Guaranteed Rs.6+/kg — same day cash, digital receipt
  • Produce converted to value — zero waste, zero dumping
  • Predictable income enables next-season crop planning
  • GlutAlert gives 14–21 day advance harvest warning

What buyers get.

Consistent, traceable, shelf-stable ingredients — sourced directly from verified farm clusters, with zero cold chain logistics overhead.

Food Processors

Consistent raw material, no cold chain cost

Tomato paste and chilli powder at consistent Brix and SHU levels, shelf-stable for 12+ months, traceable to district and harvest date.

  • Minimum order from 500kg per batch
  • FSSAI-compliant processing
  • Flexible delivery schedule aligned to harvest calendar
FMCG Brands

Solar-processed, origin-verified ingredients

For brands that need clean-label, sustainably sourced inputs — solar-processed amla powder and chilli with documented farm origin.

  • GI-aligned produce from identified districts
  • Solar processing certification available
  • Packaging to spec on request
Exporters

Premium positioning built at source

Chhattisgarh amla and Kondagaon chilli processed at farmgate — origin story and solar credentials differentiate in export markets.

  • Export-grade processing documentation
  • APEDA certification pathway
  • Scalable to multiple districts in Year 2
